messages.content: You are a senior engineer planning execution. Respond ONLY in the PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES format. No prose, no preamble, no explanation outside the labeled sections.

Objective: Design a phased rebuild plan for Tali so natal readings use Nicholas's original skill stack (Valens doctrine, planet portraits, topic verdicts with surface+terminal authority) as a vault of linked evidence, not freeform chat over a facts dump — without making new-chart creation unreasonably slow.

State:
- Live app (tali repo): chart engine + factsBlock + timing + thin voice prompts + chat. Horary skeleton exists. NO planet portraits, NO topic skills (Personality/Origins/Vocation/Wealth/Relationships), NO two-layer surface/terminal, NO vault of linked evidence.
- Original design: pipeline of skills producing thick verdict blocks; Obsidian-style vault where overlapping evidence across topics IS the finding; prose/voice only after structure exists.
- Skills Nicholas still has: valens-doctrine (Anthology natures/signs/terms/lots); personality (ASC lord primary, Moon+nakshatra secondary, Sun narrowing); origins (4th/IC, father Sun-Saturn+lot, mother Moon-Venus+lot, dasha early years); vocation (10th+MC+Spirit, dispositor chain terminal); wealth (2nd/5th/11th+Fortune terminal); relationships (7th+Venus+Eros+Moon, chain terminals); traditional-horary (Sahl/Masha'allah four-phase).
- Current engine already computes: positions, whole-sign houses, dignities, aspects/receptions, lots, some chains, timing. Unknown/incomplete: full planet portraits, Block-6 close angle contacts as first-class, nakshatra/pada, full dispositor terminals for every significator, topic packets.
- Constraint from Nicholas: OK with some drag when creating a new chart, must be reasonable — calculating ALL topic packets + full vault up front is too slow if it becomes multi-minute.

Errors: none

Constraints:
- Prefer incremental compute: critical path for first chat must stay reasonable (target under ~3–5s server work if possible; hard ceiling maybe ~10s before user feels broken).
- Lazy/on-demand topic packets OK if UX is clear.
- Do not stuff entire skill markdown into every prompt.
- Facts block remains authoritative for placements; interpretive layers sit on top.
- Horary stays separate path.
- Railway/Next.js/SQLite stack as today.

Already tried: Restored Valens doctrine into prompts + _core; confirmed it only fixed style not architecture.

Respond only in the specified format. No preamble, no explanation, no prose.
Decision_rules: true — give reusable rules for what to compute eagerly vs lazily.
